name: config_normalize_root_model_keys
notes: Harness LINKS the real C port config_py_normalize_root_model_keys with libjson; cup = degenerate-parse guard + V(compact serialized normalized config).

KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented, inputs avoid it): the C port predates two LIVE behaviors — (1) flattening dict-valued model.default/model/name into default+provider, and (2) promoting in-model model.api_base to base_url (it deletes it without promoting when no root api_base). Inputs exclude nested-dict values and bare model.api_base-without-base_url configs. Both are real port gaps worth a follow-up fix.
